_comment: Level briefing pages (the ePhone intro, level_intros in introductionToMicrobes_platformer.swf, NOTES.md 7.4): original wording with spelling slips corrected; {press_camera} / {Press_fire} are filled for the device in use (web/js/ui/prompts.js). These keys supersede the copies in web/data/lang/en.json.
intro.level1.1: We have shrunken you so small that you can't be seen without a microscope!
intro.level1.2: With your trusty hoverboard and camera phone, you have to explore the tiny world of the microbe.
intro.level1.3: Microbes are everywhere, including the kitchen. Some are good and some are bad - so watch out!
intro.level1.4: Your mission is to photograph 3 Lucy Lactobacillus.
intro.level1.5.title: Lucy Lactobacillus
intro.level1.6: When you are near Lucy, {press_camera} to use your camera phone to take a picture.
intro.level1.7: When you have taken all the photos, find the PORTAL to go to level 2.
intro.level2.1: Now we have sent you onto a human hand. There are millions of microbes on everyone's hands!
intro.level3.1: This time you have to photograph 3 Steve Staphylococcus
intro.level3.2: Steve is also a bacteria like Lucy.
intro.level4.1: In this level, you need to photograph 3 Patty Penicillium
intro.level4.2: Unlike Steve and Lucy, Patty is a FUNGUS! Fungi are bigger than bacteria.
intro.level5.1: This time, use soap to wash away Slurm Staphylococcus.
intro.level5.2: {Press_fire} to throw soap that you collect.
intro.level6.1: Skin has good and bad microbes on it. Using soap is a good way to get rid of the bad microbes.
intro.level6.2: This time, use soap to wash away all the bad microbes. {Press_fire} to throw soap that you've picked up.
intro.level6.3: Watch out for Donna Dermatophyte though! She's a fungus like Patty Penicillium but she's not as friendly!
intro.level7.1: We have sent you inside the body! Sometimes bacteria and viruses can get inside your body.
intro.level7.2: Iggy Influenza is a flu virus. Viruses are the smallest of the microbes but that doesn't make them easy for the body to cope with.
intro.level7.3: Bodies have natural defences that kill intruders. Help the body by collecting and throwing white blood cells to kill all the bad microbes.
intro.level7.4: {Press_fire} to throw the body's defences at Iggy.
intro.level8.1: We've sent you back into the kitchen. This time you're going to see what good microbes can REALLY do!
intro.level8.2: Lucy Lactobacillus can turn milk into yogurt. That's how yogurt gets made. Amazing, isn't it?
intro.level8.3: To turn the milk into yogurt, just push Lucy into the glass.
intro.level9.1: Well done! We also use microbes to make things like bread and even cheese!
intro.level9.2: This time you have to turn THREE glasses of milk into yogurt.
intro.level10.1: In an earlier level, you used the body's own defences to kill bad microbes. That works almost all of the time.
intro.level10.2: Sometimes people get really sick and the doctor has to prescribe them special drugs called Antibiotics.
intro.level10.3: The most important thing when using antibiotics is to do exactly what the doctor says.
intro.level10.4: In this level you're going to use antibiotics to defeat a SUPER infection that can't be killed with the body's defences.
intro.level10.5: You can only carry one antibiotic at a time, so you'll need to go back to get more until you kill the super infection.
intro.level10.6: {Press_camera} to use the antibiotic. Watch what it does. Does it kill all other microbes too?
